frozen_text.title: 第一章 死过一次的病蜥

editorial_assessment_not_human_quote.problem1: The only threatening adversary action in the chapter removes a small portion of ordinary feed, low cost and low immediate pressure.
editorial_assessment_not_human_quote.problem2: Large middle portion consists of paying, registering, warming, waiting and 3-day routine; the protagonist rarely confronts a new consequential choice.
editorial_assessment_not_human_quote.problem3: The ledger mystery about a beast reported dead appears at the very end, after the user's pacing tolerance is already exhausted.
editorial_assessment_not_human_quote.problem4: First chapter reward is one minor training result and half-hour field access; no meaningful increase in protagonist's agency relative to the bullying he faces.
